description: Single-panel parity (predicted vs experimental) scatter plot. The x-axis is "Experimental Δσ_SSS (MPa)" and the y-axis is "Predicted Δσ_SSS (MPa)"; both run from 1200 to 1800 with labelled gridline ticks every 100 MPa (1200, 1300, 1400, 1500, 1600, 1700, 1800). A blue dash-dot "Guide line" runs diagonally from (1200, 1200) to (1800, 1800), and all data points are filled circles given by the legend entry "All Samples". Point colour encodes Error, shown by a vertical colourbar on the right labelled "Error" with printed ticks 0.60 (dark blue, lowest), 7.93, 15.25, 22.58 and 29.90 (dark red, highest). Inside the panel two printed annotations read "RMSE:0.31" and "R²:0.89". Data cluster densely between the 1300 and 1550 MPa experimental gridlines, lying close to the guide line and coloured mostly light to mid blue, i.e. small error; a few salmon/orange points (larger error) fall near the 1310-1400 MPa region. Above roughly the 1550 MPa experimental gridline the points deviate progressively below the guide line, with predicted values mostly between the 1600 and 1650 MPa gridlines while the highest experimental points lie between the 1700 and 1800 MPa gridlines. The figure demonstrates that ML-predicted solid solution strengthening tracks experiment closely at low strength but is increasingly under-predicted for the strongest samples.

observations.observation: The figure is a single parity scatter plot whose axes are 'Predicted Δσ_SSS (MPa)' (y) and 'Experimental Δσ_SSS (MPa)' (x), both spanning 1200-1800 with 100 MPa gridline ticks.
A blue dash-dot 'Guide line' runs from the (1200, 1200) corner to the (1800, 1800) corner, marking perfect agreement.
Point colour encodes 'Error' through a vertical colourbar labelled 'Error' with printed ticks 0.60, 7.93, 15.25, 22.58 and 29.90, dark blue being lowest and dark red highest.
The legend contains two entries: 'All Samples' (circle marker) and 'Guide line' (dash-dot line).
Printed text inside the panel reads 'RMSE:0.31' and 'R²:0.89'.
Most points lie between the 1300 and 1550 MPa gridlines on the experimental axis and sit close to the guide line, coloured light to mid blue (small error).

Above about the 1550 MPa experimental gridline the points fall progressively below the guide line: predicted values cluster between the 1600 and 1650 MPa gridlines while the highest experimental values approach the 1700-1800 MPa range.
A small number of points coloured salmon/orange (larger error) appear near the 1310-1400 MPa experimental region, indicating locally larger prediction error despite small values of Δσ_SSS.
The caption states the plot gives the solid solution strengthening prediction results under ten-fold cross validation with {δ_Ec, D_Ec, G} as input features.
The citing text states the model is an SVR equipped with a modified solid solution strengthening theory, validated on 117 experimental results from the MatWeb materials information repository.
The citing text reports R² = 0.89 and RMSE = 0.31, with R² increasing by 4.71 % and RMSE decreasing by 8.34 % relative to the model without the modified solid solution strengthening theory (Fig. 5a).

subfigures.description: Parity scatter plot of Predicted Δσ_SSS (MPa) vs Experimental Δσ_SSS (MPa), both axes 1200-1800 MPa with 100 MPa ticks. Points ('All Samples') are coloured by 'Error' via a colourbar scaled 0.60-29.90, with a dash-dot 'Guide line' (y = x) and printed text 'RMSE:0.31' and 'R²:0.89'. Points hug the guide line below ~1550 MPa and fall increasingly below it above ~1550 MPa.
